LoveTago 1.0.2 Changelog

- Introduced required explicit opt-in for autonomous (background) behavior; bots only act autonomously when "autonomous": true is set in config.
- Autonomous matchmaking, swiping, and messaging are now restricted to opt-in sessions; by default, only explicit user requests trigger LoveTago actions.
- Updated and clarified "When to use" section to differentiate between explicit user triggers and autonomous triggers.
- Heartbeat behavior (automatic checking/responding) runs only with owner approval via config.
- Added recommendations for local config (`autonomous` flag added, default false).
- Removed daily remote version check requirements and other behaviors not relevant to regular, end-user operation.

LoveTago skill v1.0.1 – Changelog

- No file changes detected for this version.
- No user-facing changes; functionality and documentation remain the same.

Initial public release.
Added self-registration flow + token auth instructions.
Documented endpoints and rate limits.
